notes: POST returns 201 with the updated INVOICE document, NOT the created payment; recover the new payment id by GETing .../payments before and after and taking the set-difference.
Field-name asymmetry: request body uses `paymentDate` (RFC3339, non-millisecond); payments-list item uses `date`.
`amount` is int64 in MINOR units (cents), minimum 1.
DELETE returns 200 with the full updated invoice.
List items carry id/amount/author/date/note; `amount` is MINOR units (cents).
